description_en: Queries the status of a consumer group, including online client information, message consumption rate, message accumulation count, and last message consumption time
description_zh: 查询某个消费组的状态，包括在线客户端信息、消息消费速率、消息堆积数、最近消息消费时间
name: QueryConsumerGroupStatus

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The consumer group ID. This ID is returned after you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170388.html to create a consumer group. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170419.html to query the consumer group ID by consumer group name. You can also view the consumer group ID in the IoT Platform console by navigating to the corresponding instance and choosing Message Forwarding > Server-side Subscription > Consumer Groups
parameters.help_zh: 消费组ID。调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170388.html创建消费组成功后，会返回消费组ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170419.html按消费组名称查询消费组ID，也可以在物联网平台控制台对应实例下，选择**消息转发**>服务端订阅>消费组列表，查看消费组ID
parameters.name: group_id

AccumulatedConsumeCountPerMinute.description_en: The consumption rate of accumulated messages in the consumer group. Unit: messages per minute
AccumulatedConsumeCountPerMinute.description_zh: 消费组堆积消息消费速率，单位：条/分钟

AccumulationCount.description_en: The number of accumulated messages in the consumer group

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ConsumerSpeed.description_en: The message consumption rate of the consumer group. Unit: messages per minute
ConsumerSpeed.description_zh: 消费组消息消费速率，单位：条/分钟

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

LastConsumerTime.description_en: The last message consumption time. The time is in UTC and measured in milliseconds. Format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ"
LastConsumerTime.description_zh: 最近消息消费时间。为UTC时间，以毫秒计，格式为“yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ”

RealTimeConsumeCountPerMinute.description_en: The real-time message consumption rate of the consumer group. Unit: messages per minute
RealTimeConsumeCountPerMinute.description_zh: 消费组实时消息消费速率，单位：条/分钟

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
